## What's new: see what your map's build really packed, and why your stock override doesn't show up

- **Why is this in my fastfile?** Ask your agent and it answers from the linker's own report: the chain that pulled an asset in (image ← material ← fx ← weapon ← your `.zpkg` ← your `.zone`), and its size. Also `t7kb zone explain <map> <asset>`.
- **What makes my map so big?** Every zone line ranked by weight, then what any line brings in: count, bytes, the largest assets. On a test map, one weapons package turned out to be 60% of a 4.9 GB `.xpak`. Also `t7kb zone contents <map>`.
- **"I edited a stock script and nothing changes."** `zone_check` finds the stock scripts and assets you zoned, or redefined in your GDTs, that the build replaces with the shipped version, and gives the assetlist line to comment out. It works before your first link. Also `t7kb zone check <map>`.
- **Updates that reach you.** The plugin now updates from Claude Code's `/plugin` screen like any other. A session warns you when the `t7kb` binary and the plugin's skills are out of step, and `t7kb update-check` also flags duplicate plugin installs across scopes.
